An adnexal mass may arise from the ovary, fallopian tube, broad ligament or adjacent structures.
Common sites include ovaries, pouch of Douglas, uterosacral ligaments, broad ligament and pelvic peritoneum.
Cervical/broad-ligament: uncommon; may distort pelvic anatomy and complicate surgery or labour.

qs.q: Cervical or broad‑ligament fibroids are classified under which FIGO type?
qs.e: FIGO type 8 includes fibroids located in sites such as the cervix or broad ligament. Types 0–7 describe submucosal, intramural and subserosal locations.
